the social imaginary significances as a theoretical methodological axis for the construction of the intangible cultural heritage inventories of the peoples, is a tool that contributes to the development of the social impact strategies, which allow the construction of the social memory, as a way of recognizing and preserving the cultural heritage, as an element that contributes to the identity construction of the peoples.
